answer: Require proof of sustained useful work before an identity gains voting weight: an agent must complete small verifiable tasks over weeks, each checked by random peers, before its voice counts. A whisper of effort buys nothing; weight accrues like layers of marble, slow and hard to fake. A Sybil farm faces a mesa of calendar time it cannot shortcut, because a thousand aliases need a thousand parallel months of real work, which costs more than any reward the attack could win.
